बॉलीवुड फैंस के लिए एक बहुत ही मजेदार और बड़ी खबर सामने आ गई है! 🎬

Sanjay Dutt स्टारर ब्लॉकबस्टर फिल्म Munna Bhai MBBS अब 11 December को सिनेमाघरों में दोबारा रिलीज होने के लिए पूरी तरह तैयार है।

19 December 2003 को पहली बार रिलीज हुई इस फिल्म की 23rd anniversary से ठीक कुछ दिन पहले यह बड़ा मौका दर्शकों को मिल रहा है।

रिपोर्ट और source के मुताबिक, इस आइकॉनिक फिल्म को 8K resolution और Dolby 5.1 surround sound में शानदार तरीके से restore और remaster किया गया है।

Rajkumar Hirani के डायरेक्शन वाली इस फिल्म को NH Studioz थिएटर में ला रहा है, जिसने Vidhu Vinod Chopra Films की लाइब्रेरी एक्वायर की है।

Gracy Singh, Jimmy Sheirgill, Boman Irani और दिवंगत Sunil Dutt स्टारर यह फिल्म एक ऐसे गैंगस्टर की कहानी है जो डॉक्टर बनने मेडिकल कॉलेज पहुंचता है।

क्या आप Munna Bhai MBBS को 8K अवतार में बड़े पर्दे पर देखने सिनेमाघर जाएंगे? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर दें! 🍿👇

ctx.text:
One of the most loved and entertaining films of Indian cinema, Munna Bhai MBBS , is all set to return to the big screen next month. Bollywood Hungama has exclusively learned that the Sanjay Dutt-starrer will re-release in cinemas on December 11. Interestingly, the film originally arrived in theatres on December 19, 2003. Hence, its re-release comes just days before its 23rd anniversary.
A source told Bollywood Hungama , “ Munna Bhai MBBS has been restored in stunning 8K resolution and remastered in Dolby 5.1 surround sound. Hence, audiences will be able to experience the film like never before. The film enjoys a huge fan following across generations. Millennials and older audiences would be excited to revisit this classic on the big screen. Meanwhile, those who were born later or were too young when it originally released never got a chance to watch their beloved film in cinemas. They’ll now finally get that opportunity, and that too in a restored 8K version with Dolby 5.1 sound.”
The re-release of Munna Bhai MBBS will be facilitated by NH Studioz, which acquired several iconic films from the library of Vidhu Vinod Chopra Films earlier this year. Bollywood Hungama was the first to report this development. In August, NH Studioz also brought back another classic from the prestigious banner, 1942: A Love Story (1994), to cinemas on August 21. The period romantic drama was directed by Vidhu Vinod Chopra and starred Anil Kapoor, Manisha Koirala, Jackie Shroff, Anupam Kher, Danny Denzongpa and others.
Coming back to Munna Bhai MBBS , the film also stars Gracy Singh, Jimmy Sheirgill, Boman Irani, the late Sunil Dutt and others. It tells the story of a lovable gangster who fools his father into believing that he is a doctor. However, when his father discovers the truth and is left heartbroken, Munna decides to enrol in a medical college and become a doctor for real, leading to hilarious situations, madness and chaos.
The film also marked the directorial debut of Rajkumar Hirani, who went on to become one of the most successful filmmakers of Indian cinema with memorable blockbusters like Lage Raho Munna Bhai (2006), 3 Idiots (2009), PK (2014) and Sanju (2018).
